concerns.text: Task **T018c [US1]** is placed in the **Foundational (Blocking Prerequisites)** phase, but it depends on the US1 pipeline producing `clone_metrics.csv` and `perplexity_scores.csv`. The producer tasks (e.g., T019, T020, T021) are defined later in Phase 3, violating the producer‑before‑consumer ordering rule.
Task ID **T021b** is used twice (once as an integration test and once as an implementation fix). Duplicate IDs break deterministic dependency tracking and can cause ambiguous ordering.

Task **T076 [P]** is marked as parallel‑safe, yet it performs a **sequential refactoring** that consolidates visualization and checksum logic. This refactor must occur after the modules it consolidates exist, so it cannot safely run in parallel with other tasks.

Task **T018c** appears a second time in Phase 4 (US2) with the same ID as the earlier foundational task. Re‑using the same ID creates ambiguity in the dependency graph and may cause downstream tasks to reference the wrong instance.

User Story 2 tasks (US2) depend on the lightweight CSVs produced by **T018c** (US1). While the plan notes this as a dependency, the specification (FR‑007) requires **segment‑level** correlation and independent testability of each story. Relying on US1 artifacts makes US2 not independently shippable, violating the user‑story independence rule.
